::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 2nd [1872]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)
Here are the [Answers](organizations/other_104.qmd)  All to one question! I have read [Hanbury Mills](other_books/otherbook_829.qmd) once to myself and am now reading it to poor [Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd) who enjoys it exceedingly – I like it very much indeed – there is so much character in the three degrees of refusement, and all the people seem to me very successful- Wilfred and Frank especially & Mrs Bridgewater and Joe.  By the by in 108 & 9 you have twice made Prince Rupert speak,  if one goes by the Antecedents & Nominatives -  I think the hitch is why Scott never suspected Foster first or last till Joe discovered it.  But the way Patience is raised is very touching and charming – I think it has more life in it than [Lady Betty](other_books/otherbook_788.qmd)  Pray send me more [Face](other_books/otherbook_437.qmd)

your affectionate
C M Yonge
